notes.title: Devlog from the dungeon!
notes.content:
Hello heroes! 🥰

[h2]Guess what? We've got a prologue sketch and a little extra to show you![/h2]

We probably haven’t told you this yet - we’re adding a touch of story before the fights! Well, turns out there will be story pieces not only before battles, but also during and after them, but only in the tutorial for now 😅 Just look at the beauty we’re preparing 😍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677374/c78a568509bcdd6cc3cbf00ebe2f4449d9fa9d7e.png[/img]
[h2]Our new heroes are also starting to take shape 🔥:[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677374/01a249643c6fd434d27da6eea091583c401f9ebc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677374/1e6534b1bb40a597c692dc23b6ae1acad56f4dae.png[/img]
[h2]New h-scenes 💓:[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677374/0d76942f8b4fb72271a84c3f408799948740c5eb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677374/d798dc663a1ca16936a8c9096d3bbe68c78a8f4e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677374/c9c0d05ea38e56124eb16a4077c30bd1b7cc3e9e.png[/img]
[h2]And of course new monster 😈: [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677374/9e43454188af5a4f700607f03196fd99779d09a4.png[/img]
We also wanted to show you our new interface, but sadly we haven’t had time to add it to the build yet 😿

[h2]What else we’re working on:[/h2]
[list] [*] Getting everything ready for Steam Next Fest 🛠
[*] Adding a new level 🔥
[*] Adding new ally rooms (fingers crossed they’ll work smoothly and bug-free 🤞)
[*] Animating and recording voiceovers for the spicy stuff too 🥰
[*] And of course, our usual part - tweaking the balance 😭[/list]

notes.title: Hot Devlog 🔥
notes.content:
Hello, heroes! 😍

[h2]Here’s a little update on what’s happening and what we’re working on right now:[/h2]

We finally got down to the prologue! We realized that you (and us too) are missing the backstory of how Maya and Shana ended up in the dungeon in the first place. We’re planning not only to write out the dialogues, but also to add some fresh new art. Keep your fingers crossed that we can finish it all in time 💓

We’re continuing to draw new scenes. The very latest ones we can’t show yet (they’re still pending approval), but these sketches are brand new for you - so here you go, sharing straight from the heart. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677374/6e8d90f0a3c860fff4090543b6505b917c5e8544.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677374/5f82a1115bfb0c8561195d4d292bbb376b7a3a72.png[/img]

We’ve added new grabs to the game! And yes, they’re getting hotter and hotter 😏

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677374/e346e55c5ecc72f312007d2ae91d9713f9a71da1.png[/img]

We’re still struggling with the balance, but we’ve already fixed one problem - difficulty levels are now working! Of course, as usual: fix one thing, break ten others 😢

We’re polishing the interface -  hopefully it will become even more comfortable and enjoyable for you 💗

[i]More news is coming soon, so don’t forget to follow us and add the game to your Steam wishlist! 🚀[/i]

[i]Hi! 🏝️🍹⛱️[/i]
We have great news today! We chatted with the cool guys from [b]Lustration Team[/b] for a while. They are known for their game Lyndaria: Lust Adventure, and now they are developing a spin-off game about the priestess Shana ❤️ So, the news is that we decided to publish their game about Shana, because it looks interesting, and the developers themselves are good people. So meet Shana - [u][b]Priestess of Tona[/b][/u] 🤩

[b][h1]We will be glad if you add the game to your wishlist 🙏 👉👈[/h1][/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3757060

[h1][b]➡️ WHAT THE GAME IS ABOUT?[/b][/h1]
[b]Shana - Priestess of Tona[/b] - is an adult roguelike autobattler where you’re bound to enjoy your victories over your enemies… Or you’re doomed to be enjoyed by them if you lose 💋 Hot dungeon bosses scenes, different girls selection and more...

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44721122/7ad1a588c09aff306daf52c57a8cfaa0092fe543.png[/img]

[h1][b]➡️ WHAT’S IN THE GAME:[/b][/h1]
👑 Three difficulty levels, for those who like it easier or more hardcore
🙋🏻‍♀️ The ability to choose your battle companions and change your play style
🤤 32 juicy animations of “dominating” bosses (H-scenes)
